product_metadata.title: Safavieh American Homes Collection Liam Vintage Cream Ivory 2-Tier Open Bookcase
features: The avocado finish of this bookcase will create a perfect accent to your home
Perfect for living room, family room, den, library, or study; Always use felt pads under all articles to prevent discoloration or softening of lacquer
Assembly required, this bookcase measures 33.5" x 13.5" x 35.7"; Plastic and rubber bases on items can discolor wood
Regular attention and maintenance of fine furniture can ensure its beauty for years to come
description: The Liam open book case, crafted from elm in an avocado green finish, proves a versatile, multi-functional workhorse. With its light-weight stature and X-shaped back, this bookcase is ideal for country and beach settings in rooms throughout the home.
